en.headline: Foreign firms still backing Hong Kong, commerce chief says
en.dek: Algernon Yau told RTHK that more than 10,070 companies with overseas headquarters now have a presence here, with the United States ranking second after the mainland.
body: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said on Wednesday that overseas businesses remain confident in Hong Kong's operating environment despite swings in geopolitics.

Speaking on RTHK's Millennium, Mr Yau said the number of companies with headquarters abroad that have set up in Hong Kong had risen to more than 10,070. Mainland firms accounted for the largest group, at more than 3,000, followed by the United States and then the United Kingdom, with Japan also around 1,600, according to later local reports of the same remarks.

He pointed to free capital movement, the common-law system, the city's status as an aviation hub and access to the Greater Bay Area as reasons Hong Kong stayed attractive for trade. Hong Kong has nine free-trade agreements covering 21 economies and 25 investment promotion and protection agreements covering 34 economies, he said in related comments the same morning.

Mr Yau also said the government was expanding its overseas economic network, including a working office in Kuala Lumpur and plans for offices in Riyadh and Kazakhstan, and that he expected to lead a mission to Turkey and Egypt in January to deepen ties with those markets.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：外商對香港營商環境有信心 在港設企逾萬家
zh.dek: 商務及經濟發展局局長在港台節目表示，總部在外地而在港設立的公司已逾10070家，美國企業數目排第二。
body: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺周三早在港台節目《千禧年代》表示，不論地緣政治如何波動，外商對香港營商環境仍然有信心，香港對外資仍具吸引力。
他說，總公司在外地而在香港設立公司的數字不斷增加，已達10070多家。其後本地報道引述同一番話指，內地企業逾3000家居首，美國約1600多家排第二，其後為英國，日本企業數目亦約1600多家。
丘應樺指，資金自由流動、普通法制度、航空橞結地位，以及可進入大灣區做生意，都是外商看重的條件。他同日亦提到，香港已簽署9份自由貿易協定，涵蓋21個經濟體，以及25份投資促進及保護協定，涵蓋34個經濟體。
他表示政府正加密經貿網絡，吉隆坡辦事處已運作，並籌劃在利雅得及哈薩克斯坦設經貿辦。為打通新興市場，他預計明年1月率團出訪土耳其及埃及。
